initialism of note de la rédaction (—Ed., —Editor; editor's note;)
initialism of note du traducteur (—Translator; translator's note;)
N/M: M/S: initialism of navire à moteur (“motor ship”) A ship prefix used for motor vessels.
MV: initialism of navire marchand (“merchant ship”) A ship prefix used for commercial vessels.
n'a: contraction of ne + a (third-person singular indicative present form of avoir)
n'ai: contraction of ne (“not”) + ai (first-person singular indicative present form of avoir)
n'aie crainte: fear not, never fear, don't worry
n'aigle: alternative spelling of n-aigle, an alternative form of aigle (“eagle”)
n'as: contraction of ne + as (second-person singular indicative present form of avoir)
n'avait: contraction of ne + avait (third-person singular imperfect indicative form of avoir)
n'avez: contraction of ne + avez (second-person plural indicative present form of avoir)
n'avoir cure: to have no interest in; to not care about
n'avoir d'yeux que pour: to only have eyes for, to be all eyes for (someone)
n'avoir de cesse: not to rest until, not to stop until
to spend one's time doing something, to keep doing something, to be doing something continuously
n'avoir ni queue ni tête: to make no sense, to have no rhyme or reason
n'avoir qu'une parole: to be as good as one's word, to be true to one's word
n'avoir qu'à bien se tenir: had better watch out, had better brace oneself, to be in for a challenge
n'avoir que faire: To have no interest in; to not care about
对……不感兴趣，对……无所谓 [接 de 「某人/物」]
n'avoir que la peau sur les os: to be skin and bones (to be emaciated; to be very skinny)
n'avoir rien pour soi: to have nothing going for one, to have nothing
n'avoir rien à se mettre: to have nothing (i.e. no decent or elegant clothes) to put on
n'avons: contraction of ne + avons (first-person plural indicative present form of avoir)
n'en déplaise à: with all due respect to…; with apologies to…; no offense to…; whether … likes it or not; pace …
n'en faire qu'à sa tête: to never listen to anyone else, to be pig-headed, to do as one pleases
n'en plus pouvoir: to be unable to take any more; to have had it with; to be fed up with; to be sick and tired of
n'en pouvoir mais: to not be responsible for something
to be unable to take it any longer, to be unable to go on like this
n'es: contraction of ne + es (second-person singular indicative present form of être)
n'est: contraction of ne + est (third-person singular indicative present form of être)
n'est-ce pas: Used as an expression of affirmation after a statement.
n'importe: no matter, never mind the, any, -ever
n'importe lequel: any one; no matter which; whichever
n'ont: contraction of ne + ont (third-person plural indicative present form of avoir)
n'y voir que du bleu: to fall for it, to be taken in, to be totally hoodwinked
n'y voir que du feu: to be unable to see the finer details of a complex situation; (particularly) to fall for (a deception), to be taken in, to be totally hoodwinked
n'y être pour rien: to have no responsibility (for it); to have no part (in it), to have nothing to do (with it)
n'écouter que d'une oreille: to listen with half an ear (to listen distractedly, without paying attention)
n'éléphant: alternative spelling of n-éléphant, an alternative form of éléphant (“elephant”)
n'était: contraction of ne + était (third-person singular imperfect indicative form of être)
n'êtes: contraction of ne + êtes (second-person plural indicative present form of être)
